_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Umntu odlala ngokwakhe vs Umthengisi

📖 ISAZISO SEGAME:
• Uqala ne-{start_chips} chips
• Ideshi elilodwa la-52 kartye (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Udlala ngokwakhe vs umthengisi (indlu)
• Ilungu lolunye lolunye lalandela isakhiwo se-Ultimate Texas Hold'em: uposta ANTE na BLIND bets, ufumana 2 kartye zemali, uqala ukubetsa PLAY bets kuzo zonke izikhathi zokuphela, uveza kartye zemali zokwabelana nokulinganisa isandla lakho lesi-5 kartye vs umthengisi. Injongo yakho kukhulisa imali yakho (ukhona isandla lesi-better), ukhulisa ukhasi wakho (ukhona isandla lesi-worse).
• Igame iphela ukhona 0 chips okanye ngaphantsi komqala we-round (LOSS) okanye ukhona 1000 mizunguko nemali (WIN)

💰 ISAKHIWO SEBET:
• ANTE: Ibet eyenzekayo ${ante} yaminye mizunguko
• BLIND: Ibet eyenzekayo ${ante} yaminye mizunguko
• PLAY: Ibet eyenzekayo ngokwakhe. Kuzo zonke izikhathi zokuphela, unaweza ukukhetha kuphela INYE yezilandelayo: (${ante4} ukhona PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} ukhona FLOP, okanye ${ante} ukhona RIVER. Unaweza ukufolda ukhona river, ukususa isandla, ukwenza ibet.)

🎴 UKUPHILA KWEKARTYE:
• Ufumana 2 kartye zemali (kartye zemali zakho)
• Umthengisi ufumana 2 kartye zemali (ezifihliwe kuwe)
• 5 kartye zemali zokwabelana zikhutshwa ngokwenzekayo
• Kartye zemali zokwabelana zivezwa ngokuthuthuzela kuzo zonke izikhathi zokuphela

🏆 UKUFIHLA KWEDEALER:
• Umthengisi kumele abe nayo inye PAIR (2 kartye zemali zesandla lesi-better) ukhona, ukhutshwa kuzo zonke izikhathi zokuphela.
• Ukufihla kwe-dealer kuthinta imiphumela yebet, njengekutsho kutheni.

🎮 IZIKHATHI ZOKUPHELA & MIDLA:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Midlalo: [4x] (${ante4}) okanye [check]
  • [4x]: Betsa ${ante4} PLAY bet, veza kartye zemali zokwabelana zokuqala
  • [check]: Akukho bet, veza kartye zemali zokwabelana zokuqala

📋 FLOP:
  • Ukuba 4x bet iphinde: Kuphela [skip] ekhoyo (auto-veza kartye zemali zokwabelana zokugqibela)
  • Ukuba akukho 4x bet: [2x] (${ante2}) okanye [check]
  • [2x]: Betsa ${ante2} PLAY bet, veza kartye zemali zokwabelana zokugqibela
  • [check]: Akukho bet, veza kartye zemali zokwabelana zokugqibela

📋 RIVER:
  • Ukuba 4x okanye 2x bet iphinde: Kuphela [skip] ekhoyo (auto-ya kwenye showdown)
  • Ukuba akukho bet ye-PLAY: [1x] (${ante}) okanye [fold]
  • [1x]: Betsa ${ante} PLAY bet, ya kwenye showdown
  • [fold]: Susa isandla, ulahle ibet ye-ANTE na BLIND

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Kartye zemali zonke zivezwa nokulinganiswa
  • Isandla lesi-5 kartye lesi-better ukhona 7 kartye (2 kartye zemali + 5 kartye zemali zokwabelana)
  • Ibet isettle ngokwemiphumela ye-payout

💎 IMIPHUMELA YEBET:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Umthengisi akakwazi ukhona: PUSH (bet ibuyiselwe)
  • Umthengisi ukwazi ukhona & uwin: 1:1 payout (bet + imali)
  • Umthengisi ukwazi ukhona & ulahle: Bet ilahle
  • Tie: PUSH (bet ibuyiselwe)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Ayathintwa ukwazi kwe-dealer
  • Uwin: Bet ibuyiselwe nokuphuma kwezandla
  • Ulahle: Bet ilahle
  • Tie: PUSH (bet ibuyiselwe)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Akukho payout

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Ayathintwa ukwazi kwe-dealer
  • Ukulinganisa ngokwakhe: Isandla lakho lesi-better vs umthengisi
  • Uwin: 1:1 payout (bet + imali)
  • Ulahle: Bet ilahle
  • Tie: PUSH (bet ibuyiselwe)

🎯 IZINYE ZESANDLA ZEPOKER (Best to Worst):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 ye-suit enye
  2. Straight Flush: 5 kartye zemali zokulandela ye-suit enye
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 kartye zemali zesandla lesi-better
  4. Full House: 3 kartye zemali zesandla lesi-better + 2 kartye zemali zesandla lesi-better
  5. Flush: 5 kartye zemali ye-suit enye
  6. Straight: 5 kartye zemali zokulandela
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 kartye zemali zesandla lesi-better
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs ye-sandla lesi-better
  9. One Pair: 2 kartye zemali zesandla lesi-better
  10. High Card: Kartye ye-sandla lesi-better

⌨️  AMAGAMA EMIDLALO:
• [4x] okanye [play bet 4x]: Betsa ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY bet
• [2x] okanye [play bet 2x]: Betsa ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY bet
• [1x] okanye [play bet 1x]: Betsa ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY bet
• [check] okanye [c]: Check (akukho bet)
• [fold] okanye [f]: Fold (susa isandla)
• [skip] okanye [s]: Skip kwenye phase enye (ukhona akukho midlalo)

💡 IZIPHUZO ZESTRATEGY:
• Izandla zokwakha zesandla (pairs, high cards) zinaweza kuthemba 4x bets
• Ucinge ukwazi kwe-dealer - izandla ezinjani zinaweza push ukhona umthengisi akakwazi
• BLIND bet inaweza kuthemba kakhulu ne-sandla lesi-better (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Jonga isitokhwe sakho! Ukuba siya kwenye 0 okanye ngaphantsi komqala we-round, ulahle.

⚠️  IZIPHUZO EZIKHULU:
• ANTE na BLIND bets zinenzekayo yaminye mizunguko
• PLAY bets zinaweza kuthemba nokwakha
• Qiniseka ukuba unguqule midlalo ngokwakhe, nokuba kuphela midlalo enye ngexesha.
